references.text: The angel announces that Samson shall be a Nazirite from his mother's womb, which Samson confirms here to Delilah.
The boy shall be a God's Nazirite from his mother's womb until the day of his death, explaining why his hair was never to be cut.
The Nazirite law describes the vow not to cut one's hair, which is the basis for Samson's strength and consecration to God.
Fulfillment of Samson's words: when his hair was cut, the Lord's power left him.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson with power, showing the source of his supernatural strength.
The Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, describing how God's power worked through the Nazirite vow.
The Nazirite's hair must not be cut; it is the sign of consecration to God, which Samson reveals here.
